name: nucleation_note_click
description: Captured with `--use 0,0,0 --use-tick 6`. Three things in one golden: the observer's placement pulse (ticks 1 and 3), the click cycling `note` on its own tick (6), and the observer pulsing one tick after the click (7 and 9) — boundary scheduling, not the in-phase two-tick offset.
